title: Role of atomic chlorine in atmospheric volatile organic compound oxidation and secondary organic aerosol formation: a review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00101C, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yinghong Sun, Li Xu, Jianlong Li, Kun Li, Narcisse Tsona Tchinda, Lin Du
As a highly reactive atmospheric oxidant, chlorine (Cl) atoms significantly contribute to the oxidation of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and the formation of secondary organic aerosol (SOA) in coastal and industrial environments.
